theorem invSqrt_mul_logTranslate_thetaCuspLogSeed
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : ℝ) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
        logTranslate (Real.log n) thetaCuspLogSeed x =

    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : ℝ) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
        logTranslate (Real.log n) thetaCuspLogSeed x =
      Real.exp (x / 2) * thetaCuspSeed (n * Real.exp x)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  rw [logTranslate, thetaCuspLogSeed, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hnR]
  have hpow : (n : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (Real.log n / 2) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hnR]
    calc
      Real.exp (Real.log n * (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) * Real.exp (Real.log n / 2) =
          Real.exp (Real.log n * (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) + Real.log n / 2) :=
        (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
      _ = Real.exp 0 := by
        congr 1
        ring
      _ = 1 := Real.exp_zero
  have hexp : Real.exp ((x + Real.log n) / 2) =
      Real.exp (x / 2) * Real.exp (Real.log n / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hexp]
  calc
    (n : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          ((Real.exp (x / 2) * Real.exp (Real.log n / 2)) *
            thetaCuspSeed (Real.exp x * n)) =
        Real.exp (x / 2) *
          (((n : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (Real.log n / 2)) *
            thetaCuspSeed (Real.exp x * n)) := by ring
    _ = Real.exp (x / 2) * thetaCuspSeed (n * Real.exp x) := by
      rw [hpow, one_mul]
      congr 2
      ring

    {kappa lin eps : ℝ} (hlin : 0 ≤ lin) (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hdiscrete : ∀ z : Fin c → ℤ, kappa * ∑ j, (((z j : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, (vec z i) ^ 2)
    (hbounded : ∀ (z : Fin c → ℤ) (i : Fin d), |vec z i| ≤ lin * ∑ j, |((z j : ℤ) : ℝ)|)
    (z : Fin c → ℤ) :
    (∏ i, (1 + |vec z i|) ^ (deg i)) * Real.exp (-(eps * ∑ i, (vec z i) ^ 2))
      ≤ (1 + lin) ^ (∑ i, deg i)
        * polynomialGaussianLatticeWeight (Fin c) (fun _ => ∑ i, deg i)
            (fun _ => eps * kappa) z
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  set S : ℝ := ∑ j, |((z j : ℤ) : ℝ)| with hS
  set Q : ℝ := ∏ j, (1 + |((z j : ℤ) : ℝ)|) with hQ
  have hQ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Q := by
    rw [hQ]
    calc (1 : ℝ) = ∏ _j : Fin c, (1 : ℝ) := by simp
      _ ≤ ∏ j, (1 + |((z j : ℤ) : ℝ)|) :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod (fun j _ => zero_le_one)
          (fun j _ => by linarith [abs_nonneg ((z j : ℤ) : ℝ)])
  -- the polynomial factor
  have hpoly : (∏ i, (1 + |vec z i|) ^ (deg i)) ≤ ((1 + lin) * Q) ^ (∑ i, deg i) := by
    have hstep : ∀ i : Fin d, 1 + |vec z i| ≤ (1 + lin) * Q := by
      intro i
      have h1 : 1 + |vec z i| ≤ 1 + lin * S := by
        have hb := hbounded z i
        rw [hS]
        linarith
      have h2 : 1 + lin * S ≤ (1 + lin) * Q := one_add_lin_sum_le hlin z
      linarith
    calc (∏ i, (1 + |vec z i|) ^ (deg i))
        ≤ ∏ i, ((1 + lin) * Q) ^ (deg i) :=
          Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => by positivity)
            (fun i _ => pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (hstep i) _)
      _ = ((1 + lin) * Q) ^ (∑ i, deg i) := by rw [← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  -- the Gaussian factor
  have hgauss : Real.exp (-(eps * ∑ i, (vec z i) ^ 2))
      ≤ Real.exp (-(eps * kappa * ∑ j, (((z j : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2)) := by
    refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
    have := hdiscrete z
    nlinarith [heps]
  have hweight : polynomialGaussianLatticeWeight (Fin c) (fun _ => ∑ i, deg i)
      (fun _ => eps * kappa) z
      = Q ^ (∑ i, deg i) * Real.exp (-(eps * kappa * ∑ j, (((z j : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2)) := by
    rw [polynomialGaussianLatticeWeight_eq, hQ]
    congr 1
    · rw [← Finset.prod_pow]
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      congr 2
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.natCast_natAbs, Int.cast_abs]
    · congr 1
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hweight]
  have hpolynn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∏ i, (1 + |vec z i|) ^ (deg i) :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => by positivity
  calc (∏ i, (1 + |vec z i|) ^ (deg i)) * Real.exp (-(eps * ∑ i, (vec z i) ^ 2))
      ≤ ((1 + lin) * Q) ^ (∑ i, deg i)
        * Real.exp (-(eps * kappa * ∑ j, (((z j : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul hpoly hgauss (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)
    _ = (1 + lin) ^ (∑ i, deg i)
        * (Q ^ (∑ i, deg i) * Real.exp (-(eps * kappa * ∑ j, (((z j : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2))) := by
        rw [mul_pow]; ring
